about: Rules for the bank teller minigame (activity teller_bank, scripts/learning/teller_session.gd; design: docs/guides/TOWN_DESIGN_BRIEF.md 'Bank teller game'; purpose and progression: docs/game/minigames.md). The bear banker at reception asks the player to cover teller window 2; plush customers (house characters, data/house_characters.json, minus 'skip') come up from the queue one at a time. 'personas': each customer's story; its text is data/phrases.json teller.<persona>_ask (the request, with {amount}), teller.<persona>_thanks (since 21 Nov 2026 a short customer answers teller.impossible instead of a persona line). 'notes': the only bills on offer ($5, $10, $50, $100; user, 18 Nov 2026: no smaller change). 'min_dollars' / 'max_dollars': every amount, a multiple of 5. 'change_dollars': what a change customer brings (whole hundreds, paid back without $100 bills). 'balance_extra_max': how much a balance may exceed the request; 'short_max': how far a short balance falls below it (both multiples of 5). 'impostor_chance' (user, 21 Nov 2026): the chance a session has one impostor, a withdrawal customer claiming another character's account, so the headshot on the monitor shows another animal; 'Call the police' brings a police officer who escorts them out. 'reason_chance' (user, 21 Nov 2026): the chance a withdrawal customer tells their persona's story; the others ask with one of 'plain_asks' and thank with one of 'plain_thanks' (phrase ids in the teller group).
